title: Add Ekonomi to your home screen
ios: It then opens as an app, full screen. Tap Share in Safari and choose Add to Home Screen.
android: It then opens as an app, full screen, straight from your home screen.
androidMenu: It then opens as an app, full screen. Open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

steps.ios2: Choose Add to Home Screen. It may be a little way down the list.
steps.android2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
